avoid_supplements.name: Psyllium husk (high doses)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Combined osmotic and bulk-forming effects may cause excessive bowel stimulation and severe diarrhea
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or space doses 2+ hours apart; monitor for dehydration

avoid_supplements.name: Castor oil
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive laxative effects may lead to severe electrolyte depletion and dehydration
avoid_supplements.action: Do not combine; use one agent at a time under medical supervision

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: Both have osmotic effects; may increase loose stools without clinical concern
caution_supplements.action: Monitor stool frequency and consistency; adjust doses as needed

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: Lactulose fermentation by bacteria supports probiotic efficacy; generally beneficial
caution_supplements.action: Monitor tolerance; separate administration by 2 hours if GI upset occurs

avoid_foods.name: High-fiber foods with reduced fluid intake
avoid_foods.mechanism: Combined with lactulose may cause impaction or severe cramping if dehydration occurs
avoid_foods.action: Ensure adequate hydration (≥2L water daily) when consuming high-fiber foods with lactulose

caution_foods.name: Dairy products (lactose-containing)
caution_foods.mechanism: Lactose may be fermented similarly to lactulose; may enhance osmotic effect slightly
caution_foods.action: Monitor for increased bloating or gas; generally well-tolerated

caution_foods.name: Galactose-containing foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Lactulose metabolism produces galactose; trace dietary galactose unlikely to cause issues except in galactosemia
caution_foods.action: Contraindicated in diagnosed galactosemia; verify patient status

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of dehydration, electrolyte imbalance (sodium, potassium), and adequate fluid intake of at least 2 liters daily. Assess stool frequency, consistency, and presence of abdominal cramping or bloating, especially in elderly patients or those on concurrent medications affecting fluid/electrolyte balance.
